PlayerThumbnailAggregator.luau.description: Deduplicates and caches player thumbnail requests for one thumbnail type and size. Roblox does not expose a bulk thumbnail endpoint, so each queued user ID is requested independently through [PlayerThumbnailUtils]. Public entry points include `PlayerThumbnailAggregator.new`, `PlayerThumbnailAggregator.PromiseUserThumbnail`, `PlayerThumbnailAggregator.ObserveUserThumbnail`.

PlayerThumbnailUtils.luau.description: Reimplementation of Player:GetUserThumbnailAsync but as a promise with retry logic. Public entry points include `PlayerThumbnailUtils.promiseUserThumbnail`, `PlayerThumbnailUtils.promiseUserName`.
